steps: Welcome to Acha Região! Discover local products.
Create and list your own products easily.

claude_design:
{
  "colors": {
    "bg": "#09090B",
    "bgElevated": "#0F0F12",
    "surface": "#141417",
    "card": "#18181C",
    "cardHover": "#1D1D22",
    "border": "#252529",
    "borderSubtle": "#1C1C20",
    "textPrimary": "#FAFAFA",
    "textSecondary": "#A1A1AA",
    "textTertiary": "#6B6B70",
    "textDisabled": "#3F3F46",
    "accent": "#F5C518",
    "accentHover": "#FFD84D",
    "accentPressed": "#D9AC0E",
    "accentMuted": "#F5C51833",
    "accentGlow": "#F5C51859",
    "onAccent": "#0B0B0C",
    "success": "#34D399",
    "warning": "#FBBF24",
    "error": "#F87171",
    "info": "#60A5FA",
    "overlay": "#000000B3",
    "glassFill": "#FFFFFF0D",
    "glassBorder": "#FFFFFF1A",
    "whatsapp": "#25D366"
  },
  "typography": {
    "fontFamily": "Inter",
    "h1": { "size": 28, "weight": 700, "lineHeight": 34, "letterSpacing": -0.5 },
    "h2": { "size": 22, "weight": 700, "lineHeight": 28, "letterSpacing": -0.3 },
    "h3": { "size": 18, "weight": 600, "lineHeight": 24, "letterSpacing": -0.2 },
    "body": { "size": 15, "weight": 400, "lineHeight": 22, "letterSpacing": 0 },
    "bodyMedium": { "size": 15, "weight": 500, "lineHeight": 22, "letterSpacing": 0 },
    "caption": { "size": 13, "weight": 400, "lineHeight": 18, "letterSpacing": 0.1 },
    "micro": { "size": 11, "weight": 500, "lineHeight": 14, "letterSpacing": 0.3 },
    "price": { "size": 20, "weight": 800, "lineHeight": 24, "letterSpacing": -0.4 },
    "priceSmall": { "size": 16, "weight": 700, "lineHeight": 20, "letterSpacing": -0.2 },
    "button": { "size": 16, "weight": 600, "lineHeight": 20, "letterSpacing": 0.1 },
    "tabLabel": { "size": 11, "weight": 600, "lineHeight": 14, "letterSpacing": 0.2 },
    "logo": { "size": 32, "weight": 800, "lineHeight": 36, "letterSpacing": -0.8 }
  },
  "spacing": {
    "screenPadding": 16,
    "cardPadding": 14,
    "sectionGap": 24,
    "inputPadding": 14,
    "gridGap": 12,
    "componentGap": 8,
    "tabBarHeight": 64,
    "headerHeight": 56
  },
  "radii": {
    "card": 18,
    "button": 14,
    "input": 12,
    "badge": 100,
    "avatar": 100,
    "modal": 24,
    "chip": 100,
    "image": 16
  },
  "shadows": {
    "card": "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
    "cardHover": "0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
    "button": "0 4px 14px rgba(245,197,24,0.35)",
    "buttonPressed": "0 2px 6px rgba(245,197,24,0.25)",
    "header": "0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)",
    "modal": "0 -8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)",
    "fab": "0 6px 20px rgba(245,197,24,0.45)"
  },
  "animations": {
    "splash": {
      "logoScale": "0.8 to 1.0 over 600ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)",
      "logoGlowPulse": "opacity 0.4 to 0.8 loop 1000ms ease-in-out",
      "exitFade": "fade+scale-up 400ms ease-in at 1600ms"
    },
    "pageTransition": {
      "forward": "slide-in from right 320ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) + fade",
      "back": "slide-out to right 280ms ease-in",
      "tabSwitch": "crossfade 200ms ease-out"
    },
    "cardEntrance": {
      "type": "staggered fade+translateY(12px to 0)",
      "duration": 350,
      "stagger": 40,
      "easing": "cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)"
    },
    "modal": {
      "enter": "slide-up from bottom 320ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) + backdrop fade 250ms",
      "exit": "slide-down 240ms ease-in"
    },
    "toast": {
      "enter": "slide-down+fade 280ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)",
      "exit": "fade+translateY(-8px) 200ms ease-in",
      "duration": 2800
    },
    "buttonPress": "scale(0.96) 100ms ease-out",
    "rippleAccent": "radial expand 400ms opacity 0.3 to 0"
  },
  "component_specs": {
    "product_card": {
      "layout": "vertical, image top 1:1 ratio, radius 18 top+bottom, padding 10 content",
      "image": "aspect-ratio 1/1, radius 16, object-fit cover, subtle skeleton shimmer on load",
      "title": "typography.body, 1 line truncate, color textPrimary, marginTop 8",
      "price": "typography.priceSmall, color accent, marginTop 4",
      "badge": "location pill top-left over image, glassFill bg, 11px text, blur(8px)",
      "favoriteIcon": "top-right circular glass button 32x32, heart icon, accent fill on active",
      "background": "colors.card",
      "border": "1px solid colors.border",
      "shadow": "shadows.card",
      "pressState": "scale(0.98) + shadow.cardHover"
    },
    "detail_page": {
      "imageGallery": "full-bleed carousel, height 380, dot indicators bottom center over glass pill, swipe gesture",
      "headerOverlay": "transparent to bg gradient top, back button glass circle 40x40 top-left, share/favorite top-right",
      "priceBlock": "sticky below gallery, price typography.price accent color, bg surface, padding 16",
      "description": "typography.body textSecondary, expandable 'read more' after 3 lines",
      "sellerCard": "horizontal card, avatar 48 radius avatar, name bodyMedium, rating stars 12px inline, contact button ghost accent border",
      "whatsappButton": "fixed bottom bar, full width minus padding, bg whatsapp color, icon+label, radius button, shadow button-like green glow",
      "relatedProducts": "horizontal scroll, cards 140px wide, gap 12"
    },
    "create_form": {
      "photoUpload": "grid 3 columns, square tiles radius input, dashed border accentMuted for empty slot with plus icon, thumbnail with remove X for filled",
      "inputs": "bg surface, border 1px border, radius input, padding inputPadding, focus border accent + glow shadow accentGlow",
      "textarea": "min-height 100, same style as input, resize none",
      "priceInput": "prefix 'R$' textTertiary, numeric keyboard",
      "locationDropdown": "select style matches input, chevron-down icon accent",
      "submitButton": "full width, bg accent, text onAccent, radius button, weight 700, shadow button, sticky bottom with blur backdrop"
    },
    "profile_header": {
      "cover": "height 160, gradient overlay bottom bg fade, object-fit cover",
      "avatar": "88x88, radius avatar, border 3px bg color, overlap cover by -44, centered or left aligned 20px",
      "name": "typography.h2, marginTop 12",
      "stars": "rating row, accent filled stars 14px, count text caption textSecondary inline",
      "statsRow": "3 columns (listings, sales, rating) divided by border, centered text, value h3 + label micro",
      "editButton": "ghost outline accent, pill radius, positioned top-right of cover",
      "listingsGrid": "reuses product_card, 2 columns, gridGap 12, marginTop sectionGap"
    },
    "auth_form": {
      "toggle": "segmented control, bg surface, radius 100, active segment bg accent text onAccent sliding animation 250ms",
      "logo": "centered top, 80px mark + wordmark below, marginBottom 32",
      "inputs": "same as create_form inputs, stacked gap 14, icon prefix (person/mail/lock) textTertiary",
      "submitButton": "full width accent button, radius button, marginTop 24, loading spinner state onAccent color",
      "switchLink": "caption centered below button, 'Não tem conta? Cadastre-se' accent underline on word",
      "background": "subtle radial glow accentGlow behind logo, blur 80px"
    },
    "tutorial_card": {
      "layout": "full screen centered content, illustration/icon 200x200 top area with accentMuted circular backdrop",
      "title": "typography.h2 centered, marginTop 32",
      "description": "typography.body textSecondary centered, maxWidth 320, marginTop 12",
      "dots": "pagination dots bottom, active dot width 24 pill accent, inactive 8 circle border",
      "skipButton": "top-right text button textSecondary",
      "nextButton": "circular 56px accent bg, arrow icon onAccent, bottom-right, shadow button"
    },
    "tab_bar": {
      "height": "spacing.tabBarHeight",
      "background": "glassFill blur(24px) over bg, top border 1px borderSubtle",
      "items": ["Feed","Criar","Perfil"],
      "activeIndicator": "icon+label color accent, subtle scale(1.1) icon, small dot or pill glow behind active icon",
      "inactiveColor": "textTertiary",
      "createTab": "elevated circular accent FAB 52px, centered raised above bar -20px, plus icon onAccent, shadow fab"
    },
    "search_bar": {
      "height": 48,
      "background": "surface",
      "radius": "radii.input",
      "border": "1px solid border, focus border accent",
      "icon": "search icon left textTertiary, 18px",
      "placeholder": "typography.body color textTertiary",
      "filterButton": "trailing icon button, glass circle, opens location dropdown sheet"
    },
    "category_chip": {
      "height": 34,
      "padding": "8px 16px",
      "radius": "radii.chip",
      "background_inactive": "surface with border 1px border",
      "background_active": "accent",
      "text_inactive": "textSecondary caption weight 500",
      "text_active": "onAccent weight 700",
      "gap_between_chips": 8,
      "scroll": "horizontal, no scrollbar, fade edges"
    },
    "seller_card": {
      "layout": "horizontal flex, avatar left, info center, action right",
      "avatar": "48px radius avatar, border 2px accentMuted",
      "name": "bodyMedium textPrimary",
      "subtitle": "caption textTertiary e.g. 'Membro desde 2023'",
      "rating": "inline stars 12px + caption count",
      "contactButton": "icon button circle 40px, glassFill bg, chat icon accent",
      "background": "card, radius card, padding cardPadding, border border"
    }
  },
